title: Module Summary: Polish, Accessibility, and Deployment

concepts.name: Semantic HTML
concepts.description: HTML that uses elements according to their meaning and role rather than only for visual layout.

concepts.name: Keyboard navigation
concepts.description: The ability to use an interface through keyboard controls instead of a mouse or touch input.

concepts.name: Focus state
concepts.description: The visual or programmatic indication of which interactive element is currently selected for keyboard input.

concepts.name: Color contrast
concepts.description: The difference in brightness and color between text and background that affects readability.

concepts.name: ARIA
concepts.description: Attributes that provide accessibility semantics when native HTML cannot express the needed role or state.

concepts.name: Accessible name
concepts.description: The text label assistive technologies use to identify an interactive element.

concepts.name: Critical rendering path
concepts.description: The sequence of browser steps needed to turn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript into pixels on screen.

concepts.name: Asset size
concepts.description: The file size of resources such as scripts, styles, images, and fonts that a page must load.

concepts.name: Image optimization
concepts.description: Reducing image file size or choosing formats and dimensions that improve loading without unacceptable quality loss.

concepts.name: Caching
concepts.description: Storing resources so they can be reused without fetching or recomputing them every time.

concepts.name: Lazy loading
concepts.description: Delaying the loading of resources until they are needed or close to being visible.

concepts.name: Runtime performance
concepts.description: How efficiently code runs after a page has loaded, including responsiveness and smoothness.

concepts.name: Page title
concepts.description: The title metadata shown in browser tabs, bookmarks, and search results.

concepts.name: Meta description
concepts.description: A short metadata summary that search engines may use when displaying a page result.

concepts.name: Open Graph metadata
concepts.description: Metadata used by social platforms and link previews to display shared pages.

concepts.name: Search indexing
concepts.description: The process by which search engines discover, analyze, and store page information for search results.

concepts.name: Sitemap
concepts.description: A file or page that lists site URLs to help search engines or users understand site structure.

concepts.name: Canonical URL
concepts.description: The preferred URL for a page when similar or duplicate content may exist at multiple addresses.

concepts.name: Project brief
concepts.description: A concise description of project goals, audience, requirements, and constraints.

concepts.name: Feature scope
concepts.description: The set of features included in a project and the boundaries of what will not be built.

concepts.name: Implementation plan
concepts.description: A step-by-step plan for building the project or feature.

concepts.name: Testing checklist
concepts.description: A list of behaviors, devices, cases, or requirements to verify before release.

concepts.name: Deployment checklist
concepts.description: A list of release steps and checks needed to publish a project safely.

concepts.name: Project retrospective
concepts.description: A review of what worked, what failed, and what should change after completing a project.
